findings: Scope is clean. The only tracked change is tests/design-v4-square-product.test.js. Nothing under src/, brand/, design/, brain/ or .github/ is modified, and runs/wo-gh-7/ is untracked operator evidence.

The change adds no new I/O, network, process-spawn, eval or dynamic-require paths. The only file read is the existing runs/wo-gh-6/reviewer-design.output.md, through the existing read() helper and guarded by the existing existsSync skip. The skip semantics are unchanged.
The dynamic RegExp calls (`new RegExp(c, 'i')`) are built only from the hard-coded literals materials, light, scale and contact, so no untrusted input reaches a regex constructor.

The regexes run on a repo-local review file. The `[^.;:]*` constructs are bounded by clause punctuation and are at worst polynomial, so there is no practical ReDoS exposure. The input is not attacker-controlled at runtime.

Unsafe-default check: the matcher fails closed. An image that is not addressed, not cleared, or has an open gap is reported as a problem, and the negative cases are asserted inside S11. It cannot silently pass when the review is missing a design/reference/ reference or a gap category.
I ran `node --test tests/design-v4-square-product.test.js`: 30 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. I did not run the full 124-test suite, so that done criterion is unconfirmed here.
No secrets, credentials or model-routing config are touched. No security issues found.
